role_repair_analysis.node_purpose: Let exactly five owning specialists reconsider only the seven independently rejected financial propositions in their existing workpapers.
role_repair_analysis.input_scale: One immutable role workpaper, its original role-local context, one or two independent FeedbackReceipts and unchanged authority sets per role.
role_repair_analysis.required_outputs: One substantive revised natural workpaper draft per targeted role that visibly resolves every assigned finding without inventing facts.
role_repair_analysis.schema_burden: The repair context contains the prior workpaper, exact affected surfaces, immutable Evidence and NumericFact references, relations and typed gaps.
role_repair_analysis.materiality_quality_risk: Very high because signed contribution arithmetic, cohort linkage, stock-versus-flow, product economics and cross-company exposure are central financial truth boundaries.
role_repair_analysis.comparable_run_evidence: R5 role repairs and Lead review completed under the 32000-token thinking profile; prior 16000-token workpaper nodes exhausted reasoning capacity.
role_repair_analysis.reasoning_profile: DeepSeek V4 Pro GA thinking=max with max_tokens=32000; the node performs genuine financial reconsideration rather than schema mapping.
role_repair_analysis.stop_and_truncation_behavior: One draft per role and zero retry; length, missing draft or scope drift consumes the attempt and preserves the prior valid workpaper.

role_repair_submission.node_purpose: Map each completed repair draft into the strict specialist Workpaper contract without re-authoring or strengthening its financial judgment.
role_repair_submission.input_scale: One completed role repair draft plus the compact submission view, prior workpaper, independent feedback and locked reference authority.
role_repair_submission.required_outputs: One contract-valid repaired workpaper per targeted role with every Evidence, NumericFact, Relation and gap reference set unchanged.
role_repair_submission.schema_burden: Nested thesis, sourced claims, mechanism, alternatives, counterarguments and what-would-change surfaces must remain role-local and reference-bound.
role_repair_submission.materiality_quality_risk: A mapper error could erase a correction or smuggle new authority, so the local validator compares every authority set exactly.
role_repair_submission.comparable_run_evidence: R5 strict workpaper and repair submissions completed with the same non-thinking profile and preserved model-authored judgment under local validation.
role_repair_submission.reasoning_profile: DeepSeek V4 Pro GA thinking disabled with max_tokens=8000 because the natural financial analysis is already complete in the source draft.
role_repair_submission.stop_and_truncation_behavior: One Tool Call per role and zero retry; invalid JSON, new references, identity drift or truncation fails closed.

lead_recheck_analysis.node_purpose: Compare the five repaired workpapers with the unchanged Supply workpaper and decide whether the combined set may enter independent reassessment.
lead_recheck_analysis.input_scale: Six validated workpapers after seven assessment-bound findings and no new Evidence, retrieval result, NumericFact, Relation or gap authority.
lead_recheck_analysis.required_outputs: One materiality-ranked Lead draft that either proceeds to independent reassessment or identifies a catalog-bound unresolved challenge or data pause.
lead_recheck_analysis.schema_burden: Lead may select only challenges compiled from the six current workpapers and may not author financial facts, numbers, citations or role replacements.
lead_recheck_analysis.materiality_quality_risk: A false proceed would repeat R5 semantic adjudication failure, while an unbounded repair loop would overfit the workflow and waste calls.
lead_recheck_analysis.comparable_run_evidence: R5 Lead R2 completed naturally but missed seven independently detected errors, establishing the need for one fresh post-repair review with explicit semantic rules.
lead_recheck_analysis.reasoning_profile: DeepSeek V4 Pro GA thinking=max with max_tokens=32000 for cross-role financial comparison and materiality judgment.
lead_recheck_analysis.stop_and_truncation_behavior: One natural Lead draft and zero retry; truncation or off-catalog routing preserves the exact frontier without claiming readiness.

lead_recheck_submission.node_purpose: Map the completed Lead recheck into the strict catalog-bound coordination decision without changing the natural routing judgment.
lead_recheck_submission.input_scale: One Lead recheck draft plus the deterministic challenge catalog derived from the six post-repair workpapers.
lead_recheck_submission.required_outputs: One valid accepted and deferred challenge set, rationale and internally consistent next state with locally bound Lead identity.
lead_recheck_submission.schema_burden: Challenge identifiers must be unique catalog members and the next state must match unresolved locally repairable or data-dependent work.
lead_recheck_submission.materiality_quality_risk: A submission error could falsely unlock Writer or route unauthorized repair, so an invalid decision remains terminal.
lead_recheck_submission.comparable_run_evidence: R5 Lead strict submission completed under the same non-thinking profile; the new node only maps a newly produced post-repair Lead draft.
lead_recheck_submission.reasoning_profile: DeepSeek V4 Pro GA thinking disabled with max_tokens=8000 because this node performs strict decision mapping only.
lead_recheck_submission.stop_and_truncation_behavior: One Tool Call and zero retry; invalid identifiers, inconsistent state or truncation fails closed and Writer remains forbidden.

owner_decision_basis: R5 proved six natural Specialist workpapers and two Lead rounds but failed independent L1/L2 on seven reusable financial-relation distinctions. The user authorized continuous bounded repair. The zero-call proof binds all seven findings to exactly five owning roles, preserves Supply and every authority set, and forbids Writer until independent reassessment.
known_boundary: This decision authorizes one fresh R6 content-repair attempt over the immutable R5 six-workpaper set: exactly five role-local analysis and strict-submission pairs plus one Lead analysis and strict submission, at most twelve Provider calls. It authorizes no new S1/S2 request, retrieval, external source access, Candidate promotion, retry, fallback, authority expansion, Writer, S3 acceptance, generalization, publication or release. Every failure consumes the R6 identity and remains immutable; success still requires independent L1/L2 and content-quality reassessment.
